keywords: EIP-8037 多维计量的聚合函数分析
ERC-8049 合约级链上元数据合并
summary: misilva73 分析 EIP-8037 多维计量中不同聚合函数在不同需求弹性下的表现，聚合方式决定状态 gas 与突发 gas 如何共同设定基础费。nerolation 提交 BAL 边车 EIP，让区块访问列表独立于执行载荷传输。Vitalik 前一晚的 L2 帖引发讨论，jessepollak 宣布 ERC-8004 上线 Base。

items.title: ethresear.ch：EIP-8037 在不同弹性下的聚合函数分析
items.note: （misilva73）19:30：比较求和等三种聚合函数，聚合方式决定状态 gas 与突发 gas 如何共同设定基础费，进而影响吞吐与状态增长。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: aggregation functions for EIP-8037 under different elasticity regimes
items.note_en: (misilva73), 19:30: compares three aggregation functions including Sum, since aggregation decides how state gas and burst gas jointly set the base fee, which drives throughput and state growth.

items.title: 新增 EIP：区块访问列表边车
items.note: （nerolation）提交：BAL 与执行载荷分离、独立传输，载荷到达前即可用于预取或计算后状态根。
items.title_en: Add EIP: Block Access List Sidecars
items.note_en: (nerolation), submitted: separates the BAL from the execution payload so it travels independently and can be used for prefetching or the post state root before the payload arrives.

summary_en: misilva73 analyzed aggregation functions for EIP-8037 multidimensional metering under different demand elasticities, since aggregation decides how state gas and burst gas jointly set the base fee. nerolation submitted a BAL sidecars EIP so block access lists travel separately from the execution payload. Vitalik's L2 post from the night before drew debate, and jessepollak announced ERC-8004 live on Base.
